edges.sentence: Absolute root collar diameter and relative root collar diameter of aspen seedlings were both strongly influenced by fertilization treatments (P\0.0001 for both; Fig. [4](#page-9-0)). During the first growing season, all fertilized seedlings out-performed unfertilized control seedlings for both parameters. During the second growing season, the SR-H, SR-L, and FR-H treatments exhibited larger absolute root collar diameters relative to the IA-L or unfertilized control seedlings, while SR-H, FR-H, and FR-L seedlings out-performed IA-L seedlings with regard to relative root collar diameter growth (Fig. [4\)](#page-9-0).
